objective: Test whether the bounded shared continuous-OI shortlist ranks 16 real pretrained image backbones by the best held-out regression result attainable across four frozen head families, and whether its five-backbone shortlist is competitive with a linear-probe ranking.
scope: Single-dataset real-image validation with five disjoint training cohorts and one shared evaluation cohort. Replicates measure training-sample stability, not independent-dataset generalization.

dataset.target: integer age parsed from the official filename convention and treated as a scalar regression target
dataset.sampling: 25 images from each of nine ten-year bins per split, selected by SHA-256 order before embeddings

embedding_extraction.checkpoint_identity: Exact per-backbone revision and checkpoint SHA-256 constants in extract.py

preprocessing.fit_scope: Complete 225-row training cohort only; the evaluation cohort never participates
preprocessing.purpose: Equalize dimensionality and make the frozen quadratic reference head computationally feasible
preprocessing.caveat: PCA is unsupervised but is fit before continuous-OI cross-fitting on the complete training cohort

reference_heads.selection: Three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV using R2, followed by held-out evaluation
reference_heads.envelope: Maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen head families

continuous_oi.broad_score: RFF-mean feature bandwidth multiplier 4.0 kernel alignment
continuous_oi.shortlist_rule: Preserve the full broad winner group; restrict structured filling to the broad top-2k retrieval pool

bootstrap.unit: training-cohort replicate with shared evaluation cohort
bootstrap.interpretation: seed-stability interval, not an independent-dataset confidence interval

decision_rule.primary: upper95 bounded-minus-linear-probe top-five mean utility regret <= 0
safety: broad top-one opportunity is preserved to absolute tolerance 1e-12
the top-2k retrieval bound is active in every panel
all 20 panel-method rows are complete and finite
decision_rule.interpretation: A pass supports another real-dataset panel; it does not establish generalization or authorize library integration.
